program_solutions:
(rule!
  (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
    (lambda (r c)
      (if (and (= (at g r c) 0)
               (> r 0) (< r (- (rows g) 1)) (> c 0) (< c (- (cols g) 1))
               (all? (lambda (d) (= (at g (+ r (first d)) (+ c (second d))) 3)) cardinal-deltas))
          8
          (at g r c)))))
